title: Introducing Cloud Sandboxes: Start on Your Laptop, Finish in the Cloud
summary: Run agents on your laptop, in the cloud, and move between them with one command, all safely. Earlier this year we launched Docker Sandboxes: microVM environments where coding agents can work autonomously in a safe way.
author: PeiFang Sung
